products.name: Stealth Compression Tee
products.shortDescription: Second-skin compression tee built for high-output training.
products.description:
The **Stealth Compression Tee** hugs close to the body without restricting movement, so it stays put through every set and every sprint.

Why you'll like it:
- 4-way stretch performance knit
- Flatlock seams to prevent chafing
- Quick-dry finish for back-to-back sessions
- Reflective logo for low-light visibility

Runs true to size. For a looser feel, size up.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Machine wash cold, do not bleach

products.name: Contour Stripe Slim Tee
products.shortDescription: Slim-fit tee with a signature contrast shoulder stripe.
products.description:
A wardrobe staple with just enough detail to stand out. The **Contour Stripe Slim Tee** pairs a close, tailored cut with a clean shoulder stripe for a sport-luxe look.

Highlights:
- Slim, tailored silhouette
- Contrast stripe detailing on both sleeves
- Soft cotton-poly blend that resists shrinking

Runs slim — if you prefer a relaxed fit, we recommend sizing up.

products.name: Rival Oversized Tee
products.shortDescription: Relaxed oversized tee in heavyweight cotton.
products.description:
Built wide and heavy in all the right ways. The **Rival Oversized Tee** uses a boxy drop-shoulder block and a substantial 240gsm cotton so it drapes instead of clings.

Highlights:
- Oversized, drop-shoulder silhouette
- 240gsm heavyweight cotton
- Ribbed crewneck that holds its shape

Model is 6'1" wearing a size M for reference.

products.name: Nova Runner Sneaker
products.shortDescription: Lightweight everyday trainer with responsive cushioning.
products.description:
The **Nova Runner** is built for miles on the street and hours on your feet. A knit engineered mesh upper flexes with your stride, while a full-length EVA midsole keeps every step light.

Why you'll like it:
- Breathable mesh upper keeps feet cool in warm weather
- Rebounding EVA foam reduces fatigue on long days
- Rubber outsole with multi-directional traction
- Reflective pull tab for low-light visibility

True to size for most feet. If you have a wider foot, we recommend sizing up half a size.

products.name: Summit Shell Winter Jacket
products.shortDescription: Insulated waterproof shell built for sub-zero commutes.
products.description:
Face down the coldest mornings in the **Summit Shell**. A fully seam-sealed waterproof exterior locks out wind and snow, while responsibly-sourced down insulation traps warmth without the bulk.

Key features:
- 3-layer waterproof, windproof shell fabric
- 600-fill down insulation, ethically sourced
- Adjustable storm hood and cuffs
- Interior zip pocket for essentials

Layers well over a mid-weight sweater. Runs true to size.

specifications.label: Care
specifications.value: Machine wash cold, hang to dry

products.name: Aurum Automatic Chronograph
products.shortDescription: Swiss-made automatic chronograph with a sapphire crystal.
products.description:
Precision meets restraint in the **Aurum Chronograph**. A Swiss automatic movement drives the hands with no battery required, visible through an exhibition case back.

Highlights:
- Self-winding Swiss automatic movement
- Scratch-resistant sapphire crystal
- Screw-down crown, rated to 100m water resistance
- Genuine leather strap with signed buckle

Each piece ships in a signature Rare Vision presentation box with a two-year warranty card.

products.name: Nomad Canvas Backpack
products.shortDescription: Waxed canvas backpack built for daily carry and travel.
products.description:
The **Nomad Canvas Backpack** is cut from waxed cotton canvas with full-grain leather trim, built to age well and carry everything from a laptop to a weekend's worth of layers.

Highlights:
- Water-resistant waxed cotton canvas
- Padded 15-inch laptop sleeve
- Leather straps with antique brass hardware
- Roll-top flap closure with buckle straps

Capacity: 22 liters.

specifications.label: Material
specifications.value: Waxed cotton canvas with leather trim

products.name: Apex Vintage Snapback Cap
products.shortDescription: Structured five-panel snapback with vintage trucker styling.
products.description:
The **Apex Snapback** pairs a structured cotton twill front with a breathable mesh back, finished with a woven patch for a worn-in, vintage feel from day one.

Highlights:
- Structured five-panel construction
- Cotton twill front, mesh back for airflow
- Adjustable snapback closure, one size fits most

Spot clean only.

products.name: Street Swift Retro-Runner Sneaker
products.shortDescription: Retro-inspired runner with a cushioned gum outsole.
products.description:
The **Street Swift** brings 90s running silhouettes back with modern comfort underfoot. Leather and suede paneling sits on a cushioned midsole and a gum rubber outsole for all-day wear.

Highlights:
- Leather and suede upper paneling
- Cushioned foam midsole
- Gum rubber outsole for grip and a retro finish

Fits true to size.

products.name: Core Athletic Performance Tee
products.shortDescription: Performance tee with mapped ventilation zones.
products.description:
Built for training days, the **Core Tee** places mesh ventilation exactly where you run hot, without sacrificing the clean look of a everyday tee.

Highlights:
- Mapped mesh ventilation zones
- Moisture-wicking, quick-dry knit
- Tagless neck label for all-day comfort

True to size, athletic fit.
